fn plain() -> i32 {
    1
}

fn branches(x: i32) -> i32 {
    if x > 0 {
        1
    } else if x < 0 {
        -1
    } else {
        0
    }
}

fn iflet(o: Option<i32>) -> i32 {
    if let Some(v) = o { v } else { 0 }
}

fn loops(n: i32) -> i32 {
    let mut t = 0;
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < n {
        t += i;
        i += 1;
    }
    for j in 0..n {
        t += j;
    }
    loop {
        if t > 100 {
            break;
        }
        t += 1;
    }
    t
}

fn whilelet(mut v: Vec<i32>) -> i32 {
    let mut t = 0;
    while let Some(x) = v.pop() {
        t += x;
    }
    t
}

fn matcher(x: Option<i32>) -> i32 {
    match x {
        Some(v) if v > 0 => v,
        Some(_) => 0,
        None => -1,
    }
}

fn boolean(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool) -> bool {
    a && b || c
}

fn tries(s: &str) -> Result<i32, std::num::ParseIntError> {
    let a: i32 = s.parse()?;
    let b: i32 = s.parse()?;
    Ok(a + b)
}

fn with_closure(v: &[i32]) -> i32 {
    v.iter().map(|x| if *x > 0 { *x } else { 0 }).sum()
}

fn nested_closure(v: &[i32]) -> i32 {
    v.iter()
        .map(|x| {
            let f = |y: i32| if y > 1 { y } else { 0 };
            f(*x)
        })
        .sum()
}

fn same_line_closures(v: &[i32]) -> i32 {
    v.iter().map(|x| (|y: i32| if y > 0 { y } else { 0 })(*x)).sum()
}

fn two_closures(a: bool, b: bool) -> i32 {
    let f = |x: bool| if x { 1 } else { 0 };
    let g = |x: bool| x && true;
    f(a) + g(b) as i32
}

fn letelse(o: Option<i32>) -> i32 {
    let Some(v) = o else {
        return 0;
    };
    v
}

fn macros(a: bool, b: bool) -> bool {
    assert!(a && b);
    matches!(Some(1), Some(v) if v > 0)
}

fn nested_fn() -> i32 {
    fn inner(x: i32) -> i32 {
        if x > 0 { 1 } else { 0 }
    }
    inner(1)
}

struct S;

impl S {
    fn method(&self, x: i32) -> i32 {
        match x {
            0 => 1,
            _ => 2,
        }
    }
}

trait T {
    fn default_method(&self, x: bool) -> i32 {
        if x { 1 } else { 0 }
    }
    fn required(&self);
}

async fn asyncfn(x: bool) -> i32 {
    if x { 1 } else { 0 }
}

fn empty_closure() -> i32 {
    let f = || 1;
    f()
}
